column1: # Source directories whose basename is a bad skill name.
# The default is the source directory name, which is right for ~230 of the 260
# skills. This file is the exception list, and it exists because the name is the
# only thing the model sees when deciding whether a skill applies. A skill called
# NOT listed here on purpose: skills whose front-matter `name:` merely adds a
# vendor prefix the roster does not want — composition-patterns (front-matter
# disk-audit, docker-cleanup. The directory name is the better one there.
# Underscores are normalised to hyphens by the script, so literature_search_arxiv
# The directory says management-talk; the skill is an outsider-perspective review
# pass and the roster has always called it scrutinize.
# Two unrelated skills both called `react`. The cursor one is general React
# guidance and keeps the plain name. The hermes one is the @json-render/react
